domains.name: Application, Design, and Integration of Physical Security Systems

study_focus: Key area and important asset identification
domain_guidance.summary: This domain focuses intensely on physical security assessment plans, asset valuation, threat identification, vulnerability quantification, and detailed risk analysis strategies required for professional security practitioners during evaluations and thorough facility reviews.

study_focus: Systems integration and project management concepts
domain_guidance.summary: This domain covers security program performance requirements, appropriate physical security countermeasures, and system design with extensive project documentation to ensure effective physical security planning and operational integration across various organizational environments.

This domain addresses criteria for pre-bid meetings, procurement plans, implementation management, personnel requirements, and ongoing program evaluation to guarantee successful deployment of security measures across facilities and operational sites.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Arrive at the testing center prepared for a 150-minute exam consisting of 140 multiple-choice questions. Select one answer from the four choices offered for each question.

faq.answer_text: The official examination consists of a total of 140 multiple-choice questions designed to test your knowledge and expertise across all designated subject areas of the program.
faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?

faq.answer_text: Check with ASIS International for the current certification path and passing score details, as specific passing scores are managed directly by the official certifying body.
The exam provides candidates with a total duration of 150 minutes to carefully read, evaluate, and complete all of the assigned multiple-choice questions during testing.
The PSP Physical Security Professional examination is officially certified and administered by ASIS International, which maintains the extensive Body of Knowledge and job analysis studies.

editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the ASIS PSP Physical Security Professional exam, featuring 140 questions and a 150-minute duration across three main security domains.

methodology.summary: This page was built using official ASIS International exam guides, the PSP Body of Knowledge, and documentation regarding physical security professional competencies.

editorial.overview: The PSP Physical Security Professional examination is certified by ASIS International and tests candidates across three domains: Physical Security Assessment, Application, Design, and Integration of Physical Security Systems, and Implementation of Physical Security Measures, providing an extensive validation of professional security knowledge and vital practitioner competencies across the industry today.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Carefully and completely review the official ASIS International Body of Knowledge before attempting the test. Study risk assessment models, physical security countermeasures, bidding processes, and project management functions to ensure absolute readiness for all three exam domains without exception during your preparation process.
editorial.who_should_take: Physical security managers, security professionals, and practitioners with experience in risk assessment, system design, and security measure implementation should take this certification exam to validate their competencies.
